verses.en: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
verses.sm: Maketonia Le au uso e, matou te faailoa atu ia te outou le alofa tunoa o le Atua ua foaiina mai i ekalesia i Maketonia;

verses.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
verses.sm: aua na tofotofoteleina i latou i puapuaga ua atili ai lo latou olioli, atoa ma lo latou mativa matua tele, ua sili ai le faulai o lo latou matamau.

verses.en: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
verses.sm: Aua ou te molimau, na latou loto fua i ai e tusa i a latou mea, e sili foi i a latou mea.

verses.en: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
verses.sm: Ua matua aioi mai ia te i matou ina ia talia e i matou le mea alcfa, o le alofa fai tele lea e fesoasoani i le au paia.

verses.en: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
verses.sm: E le na o lea, pei ona matou faatuatua i ai, a ua muai tuuina atu i latou e i latou i le Alii, ma i matou foi i le finagalo o le Atua.

verses.en: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
verses.sm: Ua iu ina matou aioi atu ia Tito, e pei ona amataina e ia o lenei mea alofa, ia faapea foi ona faajuina ai e ia ia te outou.

verses.en: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
verses.sm: O lenei, e pei ona faulai o mea uma ia te outou, o le faatuatua, ma le upu, ma le iloa, ma le filiga uma, atoa ma lo outou alofa mai ia te i 11. KORINITO 8,9 matou, ia faapea foi ona faulai ia te outou o lenei mea alofa.

verses.en: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
verses.sm: E le sa'u upu poloai lenei ou te fai atu ai, a onao le filigā o isi, e tofotofo foi pe moni lo outou alofa.

verses.en: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
verses.sm: Auā ua outou iloa le alofa tunoa o lo tatou Alii o Iesu Keriso, sa tamaoaiga ia, a ua faamativaina ona o outou, ina ia faatamaoaigaina outou i lona mativa.

verses.en: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu laʻu manatu ia te outou i lenei mea; auā e aoga lenei mea ia te outou o e na muai amataina e le na ona fai, a ua loto foi i ai talu le tausaga ua mavae.

verses.en: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia outou faauma ona fai, faapei ona outou fiafia i le loto i ai, ia faapea foi ona owoo faia i mea ua ia te outou.

verses.en: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
verses.sm: Aua afai ua i ai le loto fiafia, e talileleia lea, e tusa ma mea ua ia te ia, a e le tusa ma mea e le o ia te ia.

verses.en: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
verses.sm: Ou te le manao ina ia mapu nisi, a e lailoa outou;

verses.en: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
verses.sm: 142E fai faatatav, ina ia fesoasoani lo outou tamaoaiga i lo latou matitiva i nei ona po, ma ia fesoasoani lo latou tamaoaiga i lo outou matitiva i se aso, ina ia fai faatatau;

verses.en: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
verses.sm: pei ona tusia, O le na i ai mea e tele, c leai sana mea ua toe; o le na i ai mea e itiiti, e leai se mea ua mativa ai ota.

verses.en: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
verses.sm: Faafetai i le Atua, o ie ua tuuina lea lava filigā i le loto o Tito ona o outou.

verses.en: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
verses.sm: Auā ua ia talia le aioi, a ua sili lona maelega, ua fua lava ia te ia lona alu atu ia te outou.

verses.en: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
verses.sm: Ua matou auina atu faatasi ma ia lo tatou uso ua viia i le tala lelei i ekalesia uma;

verses.en: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
verses.sm: ele nao lea, a ua filifilia foi o ia e ekalesia, matou te o malaga ma ia e ave lenei mea alofa ua auauna i ai i matou, e iloa ai le viiga o le Alii lava, atoa ma lo matou loto fiafia ;

verses.en: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
verses.sm: o loo faaeteete i matou i lenei mea, neʻi taʻuleagaina i matou e se tasi i lenei faulai o mea matou te auauna i ai;

verses.en: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
verses.sm: o loo sauniuni mea matagofie, e le na o luma o le Alii, a e atoa ma luma o tagata.

verses.en: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
verses.sm: Ua matou aau faatasi ma i laua lo matou uso, ua matou iloa soo lona filigā i mea e tele, a o lenei, ua atili ai ona filigā ona o lona faatuatua tele ia te outou.

verses.en: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
verses.sm: A fesili mai se tasi ia Tito, ua ma faatasi ma aʻu, ua ma fai galuega faatasi foi ia te outou; a fesili foi i o matou uso, O savali i latou a ekalesia, e viia ai Keriso.

verses.en: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou faaali atu ia te i latou, i luma foi o ekalesia, se faailoga o lo outou alofa, ma lo matou mitamita ona O outou.
